in_marathi.name: Hrishvi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrishvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hrishvi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, representing wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. This name is believed to bring abundance and happiness to the bearer.
